title: Kick targeting in fast iterated local search: code, data and preregistered run records
description: Reproduction package for the paper 'Vuruşları Hedeflemek İçin Öğrenmek Gerekir mi? Hızlı İteratif Yerel Aramada Eğitimsiz Kenar Uzunluğu Vekillerinin Ön-Kayıtlı Sınaması' (submitted to Journal of Combinatorial Optimization): fast 2-opt/Or-opt ILS engine, kick-targeting signals (random, kNN, excess-length and raw-length proxies, LKH-trained GNN, MLPs, online Thompson-ridge), preregistration files (PROTOCOL_v2.json with SHA-256 and OpenTimestamps proof, Bitcoin block 976258), all per-run JSON records, analysis scripts and paper sources.
